resources.string: Keeps you accountable: when you head toward Force stop or Uninstall, Be Unchained asks you to copy a passage of Scripture first, and if you turned on the prayer app lock it asks for a short prayer before opening the apps you chose. This service only watches for those screens — it does not record what you type, and nothing it sees leaves your device.
While this is active, Be Unchained cannot be uninstalled until you deactivate it here — the deliberate friction that keeps you accountable in a weak moment.

Enforces your daily time budgets for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Snapchat Stories: it watches for those specific screens and backs you out once the day\'s limit is used. It also enforces the App time limits you set. This service only watches for those screens — it does not record what you type, and nothing it sees leaves your device.
